openapi-generator.name: openapi-generator validate (Java, swagger-parser)
openapi-generator.notes: Built on swagger-parser (Java), which also powers the generator's SDK output. It does not recognise 3.2: the document falls through to its Swagger 1.x converter and fails to parse, so 3.2 is scored as declined.

cases.rule: the base document: paths, path-level parameter, request body, $refs, security, tags
a response code may be a range like 4XX, and default is allowed
x- specification extensions are allowed on most objects
an operation may use a tag the top-level tags list does not declare
paths that differ in a literal segment are distinct (/pets/{petId} and /pets/mine)
in 3.0 a schema may be nullable
the openapi field must be a full major.minor.patch version of this line
path keys must begin with a slash
response keys are HTTP status codes, ranges like 2XX, or default
a path parameter must have required: true
parameter in must be query, header, path or cookie
a parameter has schema or content, not both
security scheme type must be one of the defined types
an oauth2 security scheme requires flows

cases.note: The spec states the key pattern; the official 3.0 schema lists it as patternProperties without forbidding other keys, so for 3.0 only a validator catches it.
